hard_guards.rule: Client-side static offline-capable application; no remote backend, accounts or remote AI services.
Dexie IndexedDB is required; original no-database/localStorage-only condition is superseded for local persistence.
Migration must be atomic, idempotent and non-destructive; never delete legacy localStorage keys or overwrite newer Dexie IDs.
Use integer millimetres; honour kerf, grain, rotation, stock count and edge annotations; never silently reinterpret final dimensions.
Validate every layout, do not claim globally optimal results.
Exploded panel inventory is not a structurally validated assembly or cutting layout.
Export Python direct-model solids, not live linked native Fusion .f3d or .step; in-Fusion execution unverified.
Reuse components and recipe-based generators; do not model every furniture family as a cabinet.
3D, cut rows, BOM, Fusion outputs originate from consistent FurnitureModel; no fictitious manufacturing validity.
54 working recipes do not mean all planned mechanisms are implemented.
Current target furniture-builder with Pages base /furniture-builder/; legacy references differ.
Research did not verify installed/pinned Claude Flow/Ruflo version; version-neutral contracts only.
